news.title: Report assets restored for source previews
news.body: Added the generated report JSON assets to the gh-pages source output and updated the site builder so refreshed source previews include those reports. Song pages now load full report data when serving gh-pages directly instead of falling back to catalog summary data.

news.title: News section added
news.body: Added a News section as the default landing view, renamed the statistics view to Discography, and added navigation between News and Discography. Regenerated Oars From Strangers timed lyrics with word timestamps and added scoped final-chorus overrides so the lyrics recover from the 3:26 ad-lib at 3:39. Split the large catalog payload into a small manifest plus separate frameworks, statistics, and albums data files so the catalog is easier to edit and review. Split the gh-pages frontend into separate HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files, and added query-param routing for the Discography view, album pages, and song reports. Song report pages now fall back to catalog summary data when the full report JSON is unavailable. Added Copy Link buttons to album and song pages so their routed URLs can be shared directly. Updated the site build so the deployable _site output includes the split CSS and JavaScript assets.
